meta.title: Murderers VS Sheriffs packs
meta.publicationGate: Public items include only Dragon Pack and Batwing Pack because official game-pass descriptions explicitly list contents and usable local images exist. Other bundle families remain candidate metadata until exact contents and images are strong enough.

sourceNotes: Rows are limited to named packs with explicit official contents for exact universe 7219654364.
Dragon Pack and Batwing Pack are public rows because official game-pass product-info confirms name, price, sale state, creator group, contents, and icon asset IDs.
Medium-confidence developer-product bundle families are preserved as blocked candidate metadata, not public item rows.
Dragonpetal Bundle is not included because the official event name does not match the available Dragon Blossom Bundle developer-product row.
Raw cash packs, gift duplicates, VIP, coin multipliers, Pro Servers Pass, battlepass skips, badges, broad event-all purchases, and generic developer products without explicit contents are excluded.

imageCoverage.missingImagePolicy: Do not use weak substitutions. Future bundle candidates need direct in-game/shop captures or exact official icon captures before becoming public item rows.
